where: Results > Systematics > Genus Hypselotriton Wolterstorff, 1934 > Subgenus Cynotriton Dubois & Raffaëlli, 2011 > Hypselotriton (Cynotriton) oolong sp. nov.; Table 2, row for voucher CIB 121430, column ED
note: new trait: eye_diameter_mm (same key as main). Row quote is the table row with cells joined by single spaces; the unit is in the Table 2 caption and the column header (Voucher, Sex, TOL, SVL, TAL, TAD, HL, HW, SL, ED, IOD, EN, IND, AG, FLL, HLL) was read from the CSV export, so the ED value is the tenth cell. Licence sentence on the copy read (page-reader pieces joined): 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0), which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original author and source are credited.' Species validity: Amphibian Species of the World page opened from my own search result, heading 'Hypselotriton oolong Wang, Zeng, Wei, and Lyu, 2024', citation 'Hypselotriton (Cynotriton) oolong Wang, Zeng, Wei, and Lyu, 2024, Zoosyst. Evol., 100: 1130.', 'Holotype: CIB 121430, by original designation.', no synonymy, no DOI on the page. Methods eye sentence as printed (page-reader pieces joined, cut): 'These measurements are as follows: total length (TOL) … snout length (SL) from tip of snout to the anterior corner of eye; eye diameter (ED) from the anterior corner to the posterior corner of the eye; interorbital distance (IOD) between the anterior corner of each eye; …'. A diameter definition is printed and the unit is mm (Table 2 caption and 'to the nearest 0.1 mm'), so the trait stays eye_diameter_mm. Heading path as printed: Results > Systematics > Genus Hypselotriton Wolterstorff, 1934 > Subgenus Cynotriton Dubois & Raffaëlli, 2011 > Hypselotriton (Cynotriton) oolong sp. nov.; the article prints no Class, Order or Family heading ('Caudata, Salamandridae' appears only in the title). Earlier desks (d477, d481) reached only the CSV or the wrong paper for this id; this unit read the article_preview and checked title and DOI (Hypselotriton paper, 10.3897/zse.100.127268). Not on main (git grep of oolong, Hypselotriton and the DOI over docs/: no evidence hit). Crossref not checked.

eye: eye diameter (ED), from the anterior corner to the posterior corner of the eye; side not stated
method: digital-caliper measurement of the type specimens; Methods print 'External measurements were made for the unnamed specimens with digital calipers (Neiko 01407A Stainless Steel 6-Inch Digital Caliper) to the nearest 0.1 mm.' and define ED in 'These measurements are as follows: … eye diameter (ED) from the anterior corner to the posterior corner of the eye; …' (page-reader pieces joined); units from the Table 2 caption 'Measurements (in mm) of Hypselotriton (Hakkatriton) orphicus and H. (Cynotriton) oolong sp. nov.'
conditions: Male of Hypselotriton (Cynotriton) oolong sp. nov. Measured specimen: CIB 121429 paratype. Type material as printed (page-reader quotation): holotype 'China • ♂; Guangdong Province, Chaozhou City, Chao’an District, Mt Fenghuang, Peak Wudongding, Tianchi Lake; 23.96°N, 116.64°E, ca. 1320 m elev.; 21 Sep. 2019; Tian-Li Wei leg.; CIB 121430 [field number GEP a192]'; paratypes 'China • 2♂♂; same data as for holotype; CIB 121429 [field number GEP a191], SYS a009274 [field number GEP a190].' Table 2 caption: 'Measurements (in mm) of Hypselotriton (Hakkatriton) orphicus and H. (Cynotriton) oolong sp. nov.' Table 2 (publisher CSV export read through the page reader) has one row per specimen with header Voucher, Sex, TOL, SVL, TAL, TAD, HL, HW, SL, ED, IOD, EN, IND, AG, FLL, HLL; a species-label row 'Hypselotriton (Cynotriton) oolong sp. nov.' precedes the three oolong rows (CIB 121430, CIB 121429, SYS a009274, all M); the ED value is the tenth cell. The orphicus rows above them are not type specimens of oolong and are not filed. The Description of the holotype gives no ED in mm (the eye is 'small, not extending beyond lateral margins of head').
